admin.resetConfirm: This removes the user's authenticator app, email codes and recovery codes. They can sign in with their password only (or set it up again if the site requires it). This is recorded in the audit log.

mcp.title: Connect an AI assistant
mcp.intro: AI assistants that speak the Model Context Protocol (MCP), such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Cursor, can work with your tickets using one of your API tokens. The assistant acts as you and can never do more than the token's scopes allow. Create a token below, then paste one of these configurations into your assistant.
mcp.replaceToken: Replace {placeholder} with your token. Treat the configuration like a password.

hint.claudeDesktop: Add this to claude_desktop_config.json (open it from the app's developer settings) and restart the app. It needs Node.js: mcp-remote connects the app to the endpoint.
hint.cursor: Add this to ~/.cursor/mcp.json (or .cursor/mcp.json in a project).
